info.name: ND Downloader
info.summary: Seamless download manager for Nextcloud powered by ND Downloader
info.description: ND Downloader integration for Nextcloud: - Add HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, Magnet links, and Torrents directly to ND Downloader - Monitor real-time download progress, speeds, and ETA - Automatically sync completed files directly into your Nextcloud storage - Pause, resume, and remove active downloads - Powered by Aria2 RPC server
info.author: Nio
